from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, relationship, sessionmaker
from datetime import datetime
import os

database_url = os.getenv("DATABASE_PATH", "sqlite:///outputs/databases/youtube.db")

engine = create_engine(database_url, connect_args={"check_same_thread": False} if database_url.startswith("sqlite") else {})
SessionLocal = sessionmaker(bind=engine, autoflush=False, autocommit=False)

Base = declarative_base()


class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    username = Column(String, unique=True, nullable=False, index=True)
    email = Column(String, unique=True, nullable=False, index=True)
    full_name = Column(String)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)
    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)

    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)
    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)

@app.get(
    "/api/repositories/{repository_id}/issues",
    response_model=IssueListResponse,
    summary="List issues for repository",
    description="Retrieve issues in a repository with optional filters.",
    tags=["issues"],
    operation_id="list_issues_for_repository",
)
async def list_issues_for_repository(
    repository_id: int = Path(..., description="Repository id whose issues to list", example=30),
    state: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by state: open or closed", example="open"),
    label_name: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter issues that have a given label name", example="priority:high"),
) -> IssueListResponse:
    session = SessionLocal()
    query = session.query(Issue).filter(Issue.repository_id == repository_id)
    if state is not None:
        query = query.filter(Issue.state == state)
    issues = query.all()
    if label_name is not None:
        filtered_issues = []
        for issue in issues:
            join_rows = (
                session.query(IssueLabel, Label)
                .filter(IssueLabel.issue_id == issue.id)
                .filter(IssueLabel.label_id == Label.id)
                .filter(Label.name == label_name)
                .all()
            )
            if join_rows:
                filtered_issues.append(issue)
        issues = filtered_issues
    issue_models = []
    for i in issues:
        issue_models.append(
            IssueModel(
                id=i.id,
                repository_id=i.repository_id,
                author_id=i.author_id,
                title=i.title,
                body=i.body,
                state=i.state,
                created_at=i.created_at,
                updated_at=i.updated_at,
            )
        )
    result = IssueListResponse(issues=issue_models)
    session.close()
    return result
